upsertPapers.title: Local algorithms for independent sets are half-optimal

upsertSlices.label: Maximum independent sets in sparse random graphs
upsertSlices.task: Fixed-radius local constructions and their density obstruction share a random-input setup.
assumptions: Density within factor-of-i.i.d./fixed-radius local algorithms on G(n,λ/n). Take n→∞ before λ→∞; radius may depend on λ and accuracy but not n. This is not a universal computational lower bound.

axis.label: See scoped figure panels; incompatible objectives have separate axes

results.guarantee: Approximate maximum independent-set size within a restricted local algorithm class
results.notes: Radius may depend on λ and accuracy but not n. The red bound is only for factor-of-i.i.d./fixed-radius local algorithms. Unrestricted optimum is asymptotically twice this density; that is structural context, not a runtime lower bound.
